review:
The Dog House is the 2019 original that started one of Pragmatic Play's longest-running series. It is a straightforward 5x3 video slot with 20 fixed paylines, cartoon dogs as the premium symbols and a kennel as the wild. The wilds only appear on reels 2, 3 and 4, and each one carries a multiplier, so a line passing through two or three of them can produce a win far above its normal value.

Free spins are where the game's reputation comes from. During the bonus, every wild that lands becomes sticky for the rest of the round, which means a few early wilds can set up repeated multiplied wins on every remaining spin. Pragmatic Play's page doesn't state a max win, so we haven't listed one. The 96.51% RTP is solid. It is a simple, readable game that suits players who prefer line slots to tumbling grids.
